description: Deliverable (A): add a per-category top-predictors leaderboard to the Experts/marketplace surface, alongside (not replacing) the existing tipster grid. Data layer with a pure, unit-tested aggregation function; Redis cache-aside (key experts-leaderboard:<category>, 60s TTL, in-memory fallback already provided by lib/cache.ts); an enum-guarded API route mirroring app/api/tipsters/route.ts; and a tabbed Experts UI with a ranked table and a category chip selector reusing the marketplace SPORT_FILTERS. Metric is odds-free: ranking by win % (hit rate over graded betslips), with Wins/Settled and a Net = wins - settled losses column. Category bucketing uses profiles.favourite_sports (declared interest), consistent with the existing grid. Purely additive; independent of FEAT-001 and FEAT-003. If run after FEAT-001, do NOT reintroduce any odds field.
steps: Create lib/data/expertsLeaderboard.ts. Export `interface ExpertsLeaderboardEntry { rank: number; user_id: string; username: string; display_name: string; avatar_url: string | null; is_verified: boolean; win_pct: number; wins: number; settled: number; net: number }`. Export `const MIN_SETTLED = 1`. Export a PURE function `rankExpertsLeaderboard(profiles, betslips, category)` that aggregates per user_id over graded slips only using title-cased statuses ('Won'/'Lost') exactly like app/api/tipsters/route.ts: wins = count(status==='Won'), losses = count(status==='Lost'), settled = wins+losses, winPct = settled>0 ? Math.round(wins/settled*100) : 0, net = wins-losses. Apply the category filter: category==='All' includes every tipster with settled>=MIN_SETTLED; otherwise include tipsters whose favourite_sports contains the category case-insensitively, with settled>=MIN_SETTLED. Sort by win_pct desc, tie-break settled desc, then wins desc, then display_name asc; take top 50; assign rank starting at 1.

In the same file export `getExpertsLeaderboard(category: string): Promise<ExpertsLeaderboardEntry[]>` that wraps the Supabase fetch + rankExpertsLeaderboard in `cached('experts-leaderboard:' + category, fetcher, CACHE_TTL.expertsLeaderboard)`. The fetcher uses createAdminClient() from lib/supabase/admin.ts, selects profiles where account_type IN ('tipster','both') with columns id, username, display_name, avatar_url, is_verified, favourite_sports, then calls fetchAllIn<{ user_id: string; status: string }>(supabase, 'betslips', 'user_id, status', 'user_id', tipsterIds) from lib/supabase/paged.ts, then returns rankExpertsLeaderboard(profiles, betslips, category). Handle empty profiles by returning [].
In lib/cache.ts add `expertsLeaderboard: 60_000` to the CACHE_TTL map (single-line addition honoring the ~60s requirement).

Create lib/data/expertsLeaderboard.test.ts (vitest) exercising rankExpertsLeaderboard with hand-built profile+betslip fixtures. Cases: title-case status handling (lowercase 'won' must NOT count), win%/net math, MIN_SETTLED gate (settled<MIN_SETTLED excluded), category filtering via favourite_sports (case-insensitive; 'All' includes everyone), tie-break ordering (win_pct -> settled -> wins -> display_name), top-50 cap, empty input returns [].

Create app/api/experts-leaderboard/route.ts mirroring app/api/tipsters/route.ts: `export const GET = withSecurity(async (request: Request) => { ... }, { cacheControl: CACHE_CONTROL.PUBLIC_MEDIUM })`. Read category from the URL searchParams, coerce to the SPORT_FILTERS enum (unknown/malformed -> 'All', never return 400), run checkQueryParams({ category }) for defense-in-depth, and return NextResponse.json(await getExpertsLeaderboard(category)). Define the allowed CATEGORIES as the SPORT_FILTERS array; prefer exporting SPORT_FILTERS from app/(app)/marketplace/TipstersClient.tsx and importing it here to avoid drift.

Create app/(app)/marketplace/ExpertsClient.tsx ('use client'): holds tab state ('marketplace' | 'leaderboard'), renders a tab switcher styled with the existing Tailwind tokens, renders <TipstersClient /> for the marketplace tab and <LeaderboardTable /> for the leaderboard tab.

Create app/(app)/marketplace/LeaderboardTable.tsx ('use client'): a category chip row reusing the SPORT_FILTERS array and chip markup/styling from TipstersClient.tsx; fetches `/api/experts-leaderboard?category=<chip>` on mount and when the chip changes; renders a ranked table with columns Rank, Tipster (avatar + display name + @username + verified badge; the row is a Link href={`/l/${username}`}), Win %, Wins / Settled (e.g. '18 / 25'), and Net (+N/-N colored lime/red). Reuse the rank-medal and row styling and the pulse-skeleton loading pattern from app/(app)/leaderboard/LeaderboardClient.tsx. Empty state copy: 'No ranked predictors in this category yet.' Add clarifying copy/tooltip: 'Net = wins minus settled losses (not coins)' and 'category reflects the predictor’s declared sports'.
Modify app/(app)/marketplace/page.tsx to render <ExpertsClient /> instead of <TipstersClient /> (import ExpertsClient from './ExpertsClient'). Leave the exported metadata unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: lib/data/expertsLeaderboard.ts exports ExpertsLeaderboardEntry, MIN_SETTLED, the pure rankExpertsLeaderboard, and getExpertsLeaderboard; getExpertsLeaderboard caches under key 'experts-leaderboard:<category>' with CACHE_TTL.expertsLeaderboard (60000ms).
GET /api/experts-leaderboard returns a JSON array of ranked entries, coerces unknown categories to 'All' (never 400), and is wrapped by withSecurity with CACHE_CONTROL.PUBLIC_MEDIUM.

The /marketplace Experts page shows BOTH a Marketplace tab (existing tipster grid, unchanged) and a Leaderboard tab with the category chips and the ranked table; no odds/multiplier appears anywhere on it.

lib/data/expertsLeaderboard.test.ts covers title-case status, win%/net math, MIN_SETTLED gate, favourite_sports category filtering, tie-break ordering, top-50 cap, and empty input, and all its cases pass.
Running `npx tsc --noEmit && npm run lint && npm run build && npm test` from the worktree root all pass.
verification: From /Users/ayushkumar/development/betroom/.worktrees/experts-leaderboard run `npm test` and confirm the new lib/data/expertsLeaderboard.test.ts file passes and the whole suite stays green.
Run `npx tsc --noEmit && npm run lint && npm run build` and confirm all pass.
findings: Implemented all 8 steps as specified. New files: lib/data/expertsLeaderboard.ts (ExpertsLeaderboardEntry, MIN_SETTLED=1, pure rankExpertsLeaderboard with title-cased 'Won'/'Lost' grading, category filtering via favourite_sports case-insensitive, sort win_pct->settled->wins->display_name, top 50, and cached getExpertsLeaderboard under 'experts-leaderboard:<category>' with CACHE_TTL.expertsLeaderboard), lib/data/expertsLeaderboard.test.ts (7 passing cases), app/api/experts-leaderboard/route.ts (withSecurity + CACHE_CONTROL.PUBLIC_MEDIUM, category coerced to SPORT_FILTERS enum never 400, checkQueryParams defense-in-depth), app/(app)/marketplace/ExpertsClient.tsx (tab switcher), app/(app)/marketplace/LeaderboardTable.tsx (category chips + ranked table reusing rank medals/pulse skeleton). Modified: lib/cache.ts (added expertsLeaderboard: 60_000), app/(app)/marketplace/TipstersClient.tsx (exported SPORT_FILTERS), app/(app)/marketplace/page.tsx (renders ExpertsClient). Odds-free throughout; existing tipster grid preserved under the Marketplace tab. Verification: `npx tsc --noEmit` passes; `npm run lint` passes (0 errors, only pre-existing warnings in unrelated scripts/); `npm run build` succeeds (required copying the gitignored .env.local from the main workspace into the worktree so page-data collection could run; .env.local is gitignored and not committed). `npm test`: the new expertsLeaderboard.test.ts passes (7/7) and 1261 tests pass; the 12 failing files (arena/*, cache/isr-writes, cache/scores-upsert, economy/arena-settlement, rankings/player-detail-route, seo/public-player-index) all fail with 'Cannot find package server-only' and were confirmed pre-existing by stashing my changes and re-running the baseline — a missing dependency in the worktree node_modules, unrelated to this feature, which imports no server-only module.
